verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a payments and on-ramp service that holds user accounts, transaction history and KYC data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents any way to export user data in open formats. Related controls such as deleting a stored payment method, resetting a browser connection, or generating clients from an OpenAPI spec are different features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
